description: Call get_balance first, then confirm with the user before sending (real hours) unless they already said to send it. Delegate a task to a real human virtual assistant when the AI cannot complete it autonomously. Use this for phone calls, owner-authorized login or captcha steps (never send passwords or OTP), physical-world actions, subjective QA, manual data entry, or anything else outside the model's reach. Returns a taskId for tracking. The job is NOT started until the customer clicks Start on Work. The receipt status is awaiting_customer_start.

description.description: Detailed context, instructions, and constraints (max 8000 chars). Never include passwords, OTP codes, recovery keys, cookies, or API keys.

dueDate.description: Optional human-readable due date (e.g. EOD Friday).

idempotencyKey.description: Same value as the REST Idempotency-Key header. Required. A repeat returns the original task.

maxHours.description: Spend cap in hours (default 0.5). VA/AM stop and ask before exceeding. Actual tracked time is billed, not this cap. Max 8.

sourceAgent.description: Optional calling-agent label for the audit trail (e.g. grok-bot).

name: delegate_task

message.description: Human-readable result. Do not claim the VA has started unless the status says so.

status.description: awaiting_customer_start means the customer has not clicked Start on Work. received is a replay after start, a hold, or a sent card.

success.description: True when the brief was filed or replayed.

title: Delegate task
